description: Spend a day with Wanjiru: greetings at sunrise, shopping at the market, goodbye at sunset.

choices.label: Ndĩ mwega. (I am fine.)
choices.reply: Wanjiru smiles. "Nĩ wega! (That is good!) Come, the market is busy today."

choices.label: Ndĩ mũrũaru. (I am unwell.)
choices.reply: Wanjiru looks worried. "Ũhoro! (Oh no!) Rest a little, then we walk slowly."

scene1.culture: In Kikuyu homes, greeting everyone you meet in the morning is a sign of respect. Skipping it is noticed.
scene1.translation: "How are you, visitor!" A warm morning greeting.

choices.label: Nĩ wega! (Great!)
choices.reply: You pick ripe mangoes together. Wanjiru teaches you their names one by one.

choices.label: Tũthiĩ! (Let's go!)
choices.reply: You hurry between the stalls, laughing, baskets filling up fast.

scene2.culture: Bargaining at the market is friendly conversation, not a fight. A smile gets a better price than a frown.
scene2.translation: "Let's buy some fruits!" Wanjiru points at the colourful stalls.

scene3.culture: Kikuyu farewells wish the other person well on their journey. "Tigwo na wega" means "stay with goodness".
scene3.translation: "Goodbye! (Stay well!)" The sun sets as you wave.

title: Wanjiru's Market Day
